reasons.plausibility: The proposed mechanism of Mn affecting stacking fault energy and thus enabling or suppressing the fcc-to-hcp transformation fits known HEA behavior, but the specific role of magnetic frustration, while theoretically sound, needs more direct corroboration.
reasons.testability: They clearly describe a controlled experiment (in-situ TEM/XRD on two precisely prepared alloys) and a straightforward criterion for falsification (lack of increased hcp transformation in the Mn-free alloy), making it a robust and direct test.
reasons.usefulness: This hypothesis addresses a crucial area in HEA research—understanding and tailoring phase transformations for mechanical performance—and provides clear experimental guidance for alloy design and cost-performance considerations.
